concerns.text: T001 references `specs/001-llmxive-followup-extending-perception-o/contracts/video_metadata.schema.yaml` (missing hyphen in 'followup'); every other reference uses `001-llmxive-follow-up-...`. The schema-validation step in T001 will fail on this path as written.

T005 says the projection 'decides BEFORE any full inference whether the pre-registered fallback ... is triggered' but never states the DECISION RULE (e.g., projected runtime > X hours or peak RAM > Y GB triggers fallback). Without a concrete threshold the implementer cannot execute the decision deterministically; the rule should be named or pointed to in plan.md.

T010 re-runs 'a representative subset of models' at 8-bit, but FR-021 and plan Phase 7 fix the subset at exactly 5 models. The task should pin the count (and how the subset is chosen, e.g. fixed seed / listed in run_config.json) so the quantisation control is reproducible.

T012 produces `paper/results.md` but names no verification. Add an explicit check, e.g. every number/figure in results.md traces to a `data/results/*.json[l]` artifact (Constitution IV) and the file exists — otherwise 'done' is unjudgeable.

T009 computes 'the detectable effect size at that scale' but SC-010 requires demonstrating ≥ 80 % power for d ≈ 0.5. The task should state the pass/fail handling: if power < 0.80 at the reduced scale, the shortfall is recorded in `data/results/power_analysis.json` and reported as a limitation in T012 — otherwise the SC-010 verification is unexecutable at the 5-model scale.
